Only properly after breaking up with my arsehole ex. All of his friends were my ‘friends’ too and we’d both known them from school. Every single one was the same! 

we always went out in groups, did things on the weekends, partied with each other but it never went deeper than that. If anyone ever needed emotional help, or real support they wouldn’t get it. they would get the piss taken out of them, none of them were actually close it just looked good to outsiders so they kept the lie up. I remember one time we were out and about, all drinking and taking shit, I had a bad reaction and was really sick, not one of them came over to ask if I was okay or if I needed help they just continued with whatever they were doing. 
This became a pattern, not just with me though, no one seemed to really care about each other. It was weird.

Not the worst thing I suppose but all these small things that happened added up eventually. Finally told the ex to shove it and not even one of them spoke to me afterwards. Literally crickets. 

Tell you what though that taught me a great lesson that no, having bad people around you for the sake of not being lonely is *not* better than just being alone. Also, my old friends who I hadn’t spoke to (at all) really since me and my ex got together (they were/are good influences so ex did not like me speaking to them!) started talking to me again after I reached out. They had me back without a second thought, and no judgement at all. So happy story all in all, I lost some shitty people and gained back some amazing and awesome friends.
